name: Build APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
    paths-ignore: ['README.md', 'DESIGN.md', 'ROADMAP.md', 'SECURITY.md', 'ci/**']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: build-apk
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '9.4.1'

      - name: Android SDK platform 37
        run: |
          sudo chown -R "$USER" "$ANDROID_HOME" 2>/dev/null || true
          yes | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --licenses > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
          "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" "platforms;android-37" "build-tools;36.0.0" || true

      # The signing key lives only in repository secrets (KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD).
      # Forks have no secrets and build with the debug key; the main repo fails loudly instead.
      - name: Signing key
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" ] && [ -n "$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ]; then
            echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.p12"
            echo "KEYSTORE_PATH=$RUNNER_TEMP/release.p12" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          elif [ "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = "byteghst/permlens" ]; then
            echo "SIGNING SECRETS MISSING: add KEYSTORE_BASE64 and KEYSTORE_PASSWORD under Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions" > build.log
            echo "::error::Add the repository secrets KEYSTORE_BASE64 and KEYSTORE_PASSWORD (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions)."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "No signing secrets: building with the debug key."
          fi

      - name: Build
        run: |
          touch build.log
          gradle --no-daemon --console=plain :app:assembleRelease 2>&1 | tee build.log

      - name: Publish Latest build
        run: |
          cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk PermLens.apk
          gh release delete latest --cleanup-tag -y -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" || true
          gh release create latest PermLens.apk -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --title "Latest build" \
            --notes "Commit ${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          gh release delete build-error --cleanup-tag -y -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" || true

      - name: Report build errors
        if: failure()
        run: |
          touch build.log
          {
            echo "Commit ${GITHUB_SHA::7} failed to build."
            echo
            echo '```'
            grep -E '^e: |What went wrong|Execution failed|Could not |error:|FAILURE|not supported|requires|SIGNING SECRETS' build.log | head -n 60 || true
            echo '--- tail ---'
            tail -n 40 build.log || true
            echo '```'
          } > errors.md
          gh release delete build-error --cleanup-tag -y -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" || true
          gh release create build-error -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --prerelease --latest=false \
            --title "Build error" --notes-file errors.md
